title: Turtle WoW
description: A Vanilla-based server known for extensive custom content such as new zones, quests and playable races, plus optional challenge modes.

title: Warmane
description: One of the largest and longest-running private server communities, best known for its Wrath of the Lich King realms.

title: ChromieCraft
description: A progressive Wrath of the Lich King realm running on AzerothCore that unlocks content step by step, starting with Vanilla-era level brackets.

title: Project Epoch
description: A classic-era server that expands the original game with new custom quests and content while keeping a Vanilla feel.

title: Firestorm
description: A private server network hosting realms for several different WoW expansions.

title: Stormforge
description: A private server project running realms for more than one expansion, with a focus on Blizzlike gameplay.

title: Rising Gods
description: A long-standing German-speaking Wrath of the Lich King server with a large community.

title: Tauri WoW
description: A private server project best known for its Mists of Pandaria realms.

title: AzerothCore
description: An open-source, modular server emulator for Wrath of the Lich King (3.3.5a), designed to be extended through community modules.

title: TrinityCore
description: A widely used open-source MMORPG server framework, with branches for Wrath of the Lich King and newer game clients.

title: CMaNGOS
description: Continued MaNGOS: an open-source server emulator with separate cores for Classic, The Burning Crusade and Wrath of the Lich King.

title: VMaNGOS
description: An open-source Vanilla server emulator that aims to recreate the game as it was during each patch from 1.2 to 1.12.

title: World of Kartcraft
description: A fan project that brings Crash Team Racing-style karting into WoW 1.12: drift through Azeroth or race on 200+ courses. Requires your own WoW and CTR game files.

title: Woba
description: A free, non-commercial 3v3 MOBA that runs on the WoW 3.3.5a client, with MOBA rules added on the server side. Currently in beta.
